answer: Give each locked coin one jury ticket per epoch, with no minimum ticket bonus per account. Select jurors from the ticket river using public randomness; each ticket can win only once. A coin must complete a 30-day voyage in escrow before it votes, and remains locked while its verdict is audited. At the participation nadir, splitting 100 coins among 1,000 names still gives only 100 tickets. Buying more jury weight costs more scarce coins and a month of lost liquidity.
